experiment: one uninstrumented Linux WPE no-capture create/destroy cycle with /proc smaps snapshots

probe.actions: Sample before WebView creation, after initial page load, immediately after widget removal, and 30 seconds later; no screenshot, MHTML, or Inspector command.

environment.scope_limit: One diagnostic probe cycle only; software rendering with WebKit sandbox and GBM disabled; not product integration, hardware GBM, a leak proof, or docs/04 acceptance.

measurement.private_mib_definition: sum of Private_Clean and Private_Dirty across the probe and direct WPE child processes

interpretation: The process-tree residual reproduces the earlier roughly 40-43 MiB uninstrumented increase.
The largest positive resident mapping-group changes are the process brk heap, a WPE WebKit file mapping, and unnamed anonymous mappings.

smaps identifies mapping categories and residency, not whether the heap pages contain live objects, allocator-retained pages, graphics/JIT cache, or another owner's allocations; no leak or subsystem attribution is established.

artifacts.raw_maps_and_smaps: compressed per-process snapshots in the run directory
